name: 24. Responses Structured Output Schema Key Order (#5148 / PR #5151)
description: Issue #5148 / PR #5151: Bifrost alphabetized every nested object inside a Responses request's text.format.schema (schema fields were map[string]any and the outbound marshal uses SortMapKeys), violating OpenAI's documented Structured Outputs key-ordering contract. Under constrained decoding, schema key order steers anyOf branch selection: alphabetizing TextPart {type, text} into {text, type} makes the natural '{"type":' opener grammatically eliminate the TextPart branch, locking generation into the sibling WebCitation branch - schema-valid but fabricated output (0/5 correct pre-fix, 5/5 direct-to-OpenAI and post-fix). PR #5151 migrates the schema-bearing fields to OrderedMap. These cases send the issue's exact discriminated-union schema (each $defs member declares its 'type' discriminator before the payload field, deliberately non-alphabetical) and assert the model returns the requested TextPart, not a fabricated cite:web citation, across the native non-streaming, native streaming, and /openai drop-in decode paths.
